svg.title: A scripted rival's input, each step (driver::input)

g.text: A scripted rival's input, each step (driver::input)
input(plan, driver state, t_s, tractor state, tractor params)
before select_gear_s: neutral, clutch pressed, idle
then plan.gear at plan.throttle; from launch_s the clutch
wheels past plan.spin_ease_slip: rate = min(rate, -kSpinClutchRate x how far past)
clutch up (or back) at rate x the plan's rate; held_s += step
[engine < launch_hold_share x rated speed and held_s < launch_hold_max_s]
ease the clutch back at the same rate; held_s += step
let it come up at the plan's rate
[plan.spin_ease_slip > 0, rear slip ratio > spin_ease_slip, not feathering the launch]
fuel trimmed towards plan.spin_fuel as the slip grows
(engine::throttle_for_fuel at the engine's speed: never shut off)
below = engine < downshift_share x rated speed
(the engine is back from the launch's dip)
gear = the gear in (under way none lower)
